title: The Worker's routes
description: Every route the Worker answers. Paths are at the root of cyberspace-explorer.com, since BASE is empty.

entities.name: Serve the page
entities.transport: GET or HEAD / or /index.html (a trailing slash is ignored)
entities.result: The source text of index.html, with Cache-Control: no-cache, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.
failures: Any other method: 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD.
Any path the Worker has no route for: 404.

entities.name: Say who is signed in
entities.description: Tells the page whether sign-in is set up and who is signed in.
entities.authorization: None; the answer depends on the session cookie.
entities.result: { configured: false } without the three secrets; otherwise { configured: true, user: { login, avatar } } for a valid session, or user: null.

entities.name: Start a GitHub sign-in
entities.description: Sends the reader to GitHub to authorize the app.
entities.authorization: None: anyone may start a sign-in.
entities.result: A 303 to GitHub's authorize page with the client ID, the callback address, a random state and an S256 PKCE challenge, asking for the repo scope only with private=1; the state, the verifier and the return path are sealed in explorer_oauth for 10 minutes.
failures: Sign-in not set up: 503 with an error message.
A return address off the app's host: the reader comes back to / instead.

entities.name: Finish a GitHub sign-in
entities.description: Where GitHub sends the reader back: turns the code into a session.
entities.authorization: Only for the browser that holds the sealed explorer_oauth cookie whose state matches, within its 10 minutes.
entities.result: The code is exchanged with the client secret and the PKCE verifier, the account is looked up, explorer_session is set for 7 days and the reader is sent back to the return path.
failures: No pending cookie, an expired one, or another state: a redirect to /?signin=failed.
No code (the reader cancelled at GitHub): a redirect to the return path with signin=denied.
GitHub gives no access token, or GET /user names no account: a redirect to /?signin=failed.

entities.name: Sign out
entities.description: Forgets the session in this browser.
entities.authorization: Only from the app's own page: the Origin header must be the app's origin.
entities.result: { ok: true } and explorer_session cleared. The token is not revoked at GitHub.
failures: Any other method, or another or no Origin: 403.

entities.name: Read GitHub for the reader
entities.description: GitHub's REST API, read with the signed-in reader's token.
entities.transport: GET /api/github/<path>?<query>, Accept: application/vnd.github.raw for a file's raw content
entities.authorization: A valid session, and a path on the allowlist: user, user/repos, a repository, its git trees and its contents, with no . or .. segment.
entities.result: GitHub's status and body, its content type and its rate-limit headers, marked private, no-store. The token is never in the answer.
failures: Any method but GET: 405 with Allow: GET.
GitHub answers 401 (a revoked or expired token): the 401 is passed on and the session cleared.

relatedViews.relationship: How the sign-in routes move a browser's session.
The reader's sign-in use case calls them from the page.
